newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes finish down, rumor of deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes finish down, rumor of deal.

text.p: The discount for Alaskan crude oil remained in doubt late Friday, amid rumors a deal was done the previous day, West Coast traders said.
The dominant seller of Alaska North Slope crude (ANS) said they did not do the deal, leaving buyers and sellers to wonder if Arco, another major producer, sold the cargo.
The cargo was rumored to fetch a tighter discount than $1.53, the level of the previous deal, traders said.
With the discount uncertain, prices tracked falling West Texas Intermediate (WTI) prices.
